description: Goal intake/decomposition to execution, review, merge, and reporting handoff contracts.
nonGoals: Direct GitHub transport, mutation boundaries, and external-system adapters remain shared package and CLI ownership (for example packages/github-adapter and packages/factory-runtime-guard).
Factory-supervisor tick cadence, detached-run spawning, lease lifecycle, and bug-fast policy remain managed-supervisor shell/runtime responsibilities.
This package adds no new Hatch runtime handlers; it composes existing tool, pipeline, agent.worktree, and codergen handlers.
This package does not provide example-trading rebuild behavior or any wave-compatibility abstraction layer.
This package does not require factories to execute mothership-local goal_execute or goal_issue_execute graphs.

telemetry.description: Software-development entrypoints emit the standard Hatch workflow lifecycle and quality signals.
telemetry.title: Workflow runtime telemetry

ownedStages.scope: Goal decomposition handoff, executable-goal list materialization, and deterministic context export for downstream execution.
Execution/review/merge/release context normalization and capability skill-path resolution.
Goal-issue worktree setup, coder session orchestration, evidence generation, and deterministic commit handoff.
Reviewer context contracts, reviewer verdict routing, and bounded revise/retry messaging.
Merge candidate split, judge contract gates, rebase/merge/push ceremony, and post-merge closure/report payloads.
Issue postmortem routing, review/merge failure handling, recovery packets, and deterministic terminal status.

workflows/goal_execute/goal_execute.work.sessionBehavior: Runs the shared goal and sub-issue execution loop and delegates per-issue coding and review sessions to workflows/goal_issue_execute/goal_issue_execute.workflow-source.mjs.

workflows/goal_execution_handoff/goal_ex.sessionBehavior: Deterministic handoff normalization only. This entrypoint starts no new LLM session and assumes downstream execution, review, merge, and reporting graphs manage their own role/session policy.

workflows/goal_intake_to_execution_hando.sessionBehavior: Delegates decomposition session semantics to packages/capability-goal-decomposition/workflows/goal_run/goal_run.workflow-source.mjs. Consumers must treat exported context and artifacts as canonical handoff state.

workflows/goal_issue_execute/goal_issue_.sessionBehavior: Owns per-issue build and review retry sessions within a shared goal branch and returns deterministic impl_result payloads to the parent goal_execute loop.

title: Software Development Capability
